QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_TRUE`/`MBEDTLS_CT_FALSE` are produced through `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` (`constant_time_impl.h:85`). On the assembly path that is `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))`, a no-op the optimizer cannot see through, so it cannot prove the value at compile time
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier hiding values from the optimizer and locates it in constant_time_impl.h.
